reason: My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, she did not tell me to take a supplement. I would want a blood test result first before spending money on a monthly box.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Lab testing is nice, but it does not tell me it will help me sleep or feel better.
would_change_my_mind: A blood test showing my magnesium is actually low and my doctor saying to take this kind of magnesium.
